author: KadirGarib
body:
First off, the explanation, ground up:

Only have I recently found out that I had been banned from Avicus. The week that the ban had occurred, my 13 year old cousin was at my house, and they were visiting us for about 2 weeks. He doesn't have a minecraft account, and he mooches off a friends account. He practically destroyed that account whilst through hacking, swearing, etc. Eventually he had no "fun" servers to play on. When he came over approximately 3 weeks ago, he saw that I had an account and asked if he could use it, which I hesitantly allowed. I knew he was going to do something ridiculous, and I told him not to do anything that'll mess up my account, and he reluctantly agreed. He was on vacation, while I was at school, and doing a part-time job. Usually, I somehow manage to spare a couple hours to play video-games, typically minecraft and/or an outdoor activity. The school year is narrowing down on me, and teachers have been recently loading us with more work, above the part-time job I do as well. Playing a game on my leisure time was something that was able to balance out the stress put on me. Anyhow I recently found out that my cousin got this account banned on Avicus for flying, and he appealed relatively immaturely. When he found out that this account wasn't going to get unbanned anytime soon, he moved to OCN, again, destroying a relatively clean reputation I once had. I then requested my account to be suspended there.

I'd like to respectfully appeal on my behalf, and I hope you will believe my story. I can't figure how to prove it to you though, sorry.

  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) - pi2
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned - Flying
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. - See above reasoning

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? It was a true ban, but please see the reasoning above
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? Again, this was a true ban.
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? I didn't know about it until recently (This past Sunday)
  • Have I been caught ban evading? No.
  • Have I appealed a ban before? Me on this account, no. My cousin on this account, yes.
I understand that this is my account, and I hold full responsibility of what happens on it. I hope this can be pardoned though, as it wasn't me that was using the account atm of the incident, and as well as the initial appeal. He was also pretty vulgar to staff. I'll make sure nothing (as listed) will happen again.

I also saw that he said something about Cubition. He lied there, he doesn't have any ownership of Cubition whatsoever. I only told him about it, didn't necessarily expect him to add that to his appeal.

Again, I'm really sorry for the confusion and what had happened. I hope this will be pardoned.

title: I have some dire explanation.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: How old is your cousin and what is Cubition? Why would he advertise it as well?
replies.body_tagged: How old is your cousin and what is Cubition? Why would he advertise it as well?

replies.author: KadirGarib
replies.body:
I said it in the post, he's 13. I'm not sure if you saw it or not, but I made a thread on Cubition here around the time when I joined Avicus. I'm not sure why he would say he 'has to work on Cubition', probably just to show that he doesn't give a damn about the ban after it had been rejected, and that he has other things to do, But I don't know what went through his mind when he made the appeal. I only told him about it.

Edit: Cubition is just a sandbox game that's been in progress for nearly a year.

Edit 2: Might I also add then when I logged into Minecraft, I saw that the User Profile was set at "Reflex". And when I look at the kill-death, I could never reach that amount, and nor could he. I'd assume he also had kill-aura enabled, at least based on the fact that I can't get that many kills in one day.

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

It does not matter who was on the account prior to the ban.
Instead of blaming the infraction on others you should try to just own up to it and appeal it. 

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
